skill.name: create-auth-skill
skill.description: Scaffold and implement authentication in TypeScript and JavaScript applications using Better Auth.
skill.summary: Guides Better Auth setup across frameworks, databases, auth methods, plugins, migrations, and UI pages.
skill.author: better-auth

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code, setup commands, documentation links, and placeholder environment variables. No prompt injection, hidden execution, data exfiltration, or malicious intent was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Setup commands install packages and run migrations.
remediation.suggestion: Keep requiring explicit user confirmation before package installation, code changes, and database migrations.

remediation.issue: The skill includes placeholder secrets and database connection values.
remediation.suggestion: Remind users to generate unique production secrets and never commit real environment values.

content.user_title: Add Better Auth to JavaScript Apps
content.value_statement: Authentication setup is easy to misconfigure across frameworks, databases, providers, and security options. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through a planned Better Auth implementation.
actual_capabilities: Detects common JavaScript frameworks, package managers, databases, ORMs, and existing auth libraries.
Asks structured planning questions before implementation begins.
Maps Better Auth setup steps for Next.js, SvelteKit, Nuxt, Astro, Express, Hono, and SolidStart.
Guides installation, server configuration, client configuration, route handlers, and migrations.
Covers OAuth providers, email and password auth, passkeys, 2FA, organizations, admin, and API bearer tokens.
Provides security checklist items for secrets, secure cookies, trusted origins, rate limits, and account linking.
limitations: Does not include full source code for every framework or provider combination.
Requires user confirmation before implementation and migrations.
Relies on current Better Auth documentation for exact API details.
OAuth credentials and production environment variables must be created outside the skill.

use_cases.title: Add login to an existing web app
use_cases.description: Use the skill to detect the stack, choose a database adapter, add route handlers, and create sign-in pages.

use_cases.title: Plan a migration from another auth library
use_cases.description: Use the skill to audit the current auth setup and plan an incremental Better Auth migration.

use_cases.title: Configure advanced auth features
use_cases.description: Use the skill to add OAuth, email verification, 2FA, organizations, admin tools, or passkeys.

prompt_templates.title: Start a basic auth setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a known project
prompt_templates.prompt: Use create-auth-skill to add Better Auth to this project. Detect the framework and database, then ask me the required planning questions.

prompt_templates.title: Add OAuth providers
prompt_templates.scenario: Add social sign-in to an existing app
prompt_templates.prompt: Use create-auth-skill to add Google and GitHub sign-in with Better Auth. Confirm the route handler, environment variables, and callback URLs before editing files.

prompt_templates.title: Plan an auth migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Use create-auth-skill to review the current auth implementation and propose a phased migration to Better Auth without changing code yet.

prompt_templates.title: Build a secure full setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Use create-auth-skill to implement Better Auth with email verification, password reset, 2FA, organizations, secure cookies, trusted origins, and database migrations.

output_examples.input: Add Better Auth to my Next.js app with Prisma and Google login.
output_examples.output: A planning checklist that identifies Next.js App Router, Prisma, Google OAuth, required environment variables, route handler setup, and migration steps.

output_examples.input: Migrate my app from NextAuth to Better Auth.
output_examples.output: A phased migration plan covering current auth review, parallel Better Auth setup, route migration, session updates, UI changes, and cleanup.

output_examples.input: Set up email and password auth with password reset.
output_examples.output: A guided implementation plan for server config, client helpers, email provider choices, reset pages, verification flow, and security checks.

best_practices: Confirm the implementation plan before installing packages, editing auth files, or running migrations.
Use production secrets, secure cookies, trusted origins, and rate limits before deployment.
Re-run schema generation or migrations after adding Better Auth plugins.
anti_patterns: Do not copy placeholder secrets or database URLs into production.
Do not disable CSRF protection or skip trusted origin configuration.
Do not run migrations against production without a backup and review.

faq.question: Does this skill create a new application from scratch?
faq.answer: It can guide new project setup, but it focuses on adding Better Auth to TypeScript and JavaScript applications.

faq.question: Which frameworks does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers common patterns for Next.js, SvelteKit, Nuxt, Astro, Express, Hono, SolidStart, and related JavaScript stacks.

faq.question: Can it configure OAuth providers?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides provider selection and environment variable setup for providers such as Google, GitHub, Apple, Microsoft, Discord, and Twitter/X.

faq.question: Does it handle database migrations?
faq.answer: It explains Better Auth CLI generation and migration commands for built-in, Prisma, and Drizzle setups.

faq.question: Can it add auth UI pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It asks which pages are needed and guides sign-in, sign-up, password reset, and verification page creation.

faq.question: Is it safe for production use?
faq.answer: It includes a security checklist, but users must review secrets, cookie settings, origins, rate limits, and migrations before production deployment.
